_note: The four people on the phone in the slice. All fictional. cost_factor is multiplied by the price level to get roubles.

director.name: Pyotr Gavrilovich, factory director
director.opens: He will talk about his factory, for the right envelope.
director.declines: He does not take your call: you are in the wrong office.

banker.name: Inna Markovna, bank clerk
banker.opens: She can find you vouchers from people who would rather have rent money.
banker.declines: She has no vouchers to spare until they are issued.

brigade.name: Sasha from the Tulskaya brigade
brigade.opens: He says a firm like yours should have a roof, and that he is a reasonable man.
brigade.declines: He yawns: you own nothing worth protecting yet.

major.name: Major Belov, formerly of the Committee
major.opens: A file on your desk goes missing. He does not say how.
